# Releases {#sec-releases}

::: {.callout-note}
## Being written
This chapter is part of the September 2026 revamp of the book (the plan is in
[CalCOFI/workflows](https://github.com/CalCOFI/workflows/tree/main/.claude/plans)) and lands in the
order the plan gives. What it will hold:

What a release is (a date, a catalog, its parquet objects, a DOI), what ships beside it, how objects are content-addressed and what `since` means, which versions are kept and how to pin one, the release notes as the database's changelog, and what a release checks before it ships.
:::
